title: Companion shared-link recovery
description: Requires the explicit private Gateway/proxy receipts and a warm mounted run; never injects client or cache state.

proofTargets.claim: Normal recovery reads the same mounted run without executing or replaying a command.

visible.intent: The same run is visible after normal reconnect.

image.intent: Retain the recovered run without a user refresh.

proof.intent: Correlate a fresh source read and unchanged instruction history.

proved.intent: Recovery must not replay a worker instruction.
